verdict.rationale: Zapier documents its own programmatic surfaces: a Workflow API for embedding workflow building, an SDK and SDK CLI for running actions across 9,000+ apps, a stored-actions endpoint, and an MCP server. None of the evidence claims or shows that everything in the UI (Zap editing and management, Canvas, Agents, troubleshooting) is available through the API, and probes for a public OpenAPI spec all returned 404. missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, API coverage for Zap creation and management, API coverage for Canvas and Agents, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use Zapier's Workflow API and 9,000 integrations to power a built-in automation experience, integration marketplace, or AI workflows.
Install @zapier/zapier-sdk via npm, authenticate with OAuth or client credentials, and execute actions across 9,000+ apps.
Creates a new stored action entry that can then be executed from a simpler call to /stored-actions with just the stored action `id`.
Bring Zapier’s automation into your own product so customers can build workflows and run actions without leaving your app.
